login_telegram_subtitle: Sign in with your Telegram account
login_phone_hint: OTP is sent via Bale — you need a Bale account
login_disclaimer: This is a skill-based prediction game. No real money, stakes, or gambling.
login_invalid_phone: Enter a valid Iranian mobile number (e.g. 0912...)
login_username_subtitle: Choose a public username — others will see this, not your phone number
login_username_hint: 3–20 characters. Letters, numbers, and underscores. Must start with a letter.
login_username_too_short: Username must be at least 3 characters
login_username_too_long: Username must be 20 characters or less
login_username_invalid: Use only letters, numbers, and underscores. Must start with a letter.
dashboard_intro: Predict match results, group standings, and tournament extras. Earn points — no betting.
dashboard_no_scores: No scores yet — be the first!
dashboard_rules_teaser: Points, coins, locking windows, and public profiles are explained on the rules page.
predict_stage_locked: This stage unlocks after the previous round is complete.
standings_intro: Predict final positions (1–4) for each team in every group.
bracket_intro: Your bracket is built from match predictions. Picks must stay consistent across rounds.
extras_intro: Champion, runner-up, top scorer, and dark horse picks. Locked at tournament start.
extras_failed: Failed to save — check your picks
leaderboard_intro: Ranked by total points, then exact scores, then earliest submission.
leaderboard_empty: No scores yet. Make predictions to appear on the board!
admin_reseed_confirm: This deletes all predictions and reseeds 48 teams. Continue?
rules_intro: Everything you need to know about points, coins, locking, and public predictions.
rules_not_gambling_1: This is a skill-based prediction game. No real money, stakes, or cash prizes.
rules_not_gambling_2: Coins are virtual budget points only — they cannot be bought, sold, or withdrawn.
rules_not_gambling_3: The leaderboard ranks skill (points), not coin balance.
rules_points_intro: You earn points when your predictions match official results. Higher points = higher rank.
rules_locking_match: Match scores lock {minutes} minutes before kickoff.
rules_locking_stages: Knockout stages unlock progressively after the previous round completes.
rules_locking_knockout_draw: Knockout matches cannot end in a draw — you must pick a winner.
rules_locking_bracket: Knockout picks must stay consistent across the full bracket tree.
rules_locking_extras: Group standings and tournament extras lock at tournament start.
rules_coins_intro: Each player starts with a coin balance. Spending coins lets you predict and edit; earning them back rewards accuracy.
rules_coins_starting_value: You begin with {coins} coins for the tournament.
rules_coins_late_normal: Normal window: standard cost until 15 minutes before kickoff.
rules_coins_late_final: Final minutes ({minutes}–{stop} min before): {multiplier}× cost (limited per day).
rules_coins_note: Correct predictions always earn full points regardless of when you submitted or how many coins you spent.
rules_public_username: Every player chooses a unique username at sign-in.
rules_public_predictions: Anyone signed in can view another player's predictions by username.
rules_public_phone: Phone numbers are never shown on profiles or the leaderboard.
